$comment: Single-sourced from concordance scope §7.6 + plan §6 + decision #246. POST /trace request body. When `to_urn` is provided the resolver runs A* shortest-path; when omitted it runs BFS-bounded outbound enumeration up to max_depth, capped at max_paths. See concordance/src/concordance/trace.py for the runtime contract.
title: TraceRequest

from_urn.description: URN of the start entity. 404 if not in the catalog.

to_urn.description: URN of the target entity. When present → A* shortest-path. When omitted → BFS-bounded outbound enumeration. 404 if specified but not in the catalog.

max_depth.description: Hop ceiling for traversal. Bounded [1, 6] per concordance/src/concordance/trace.py TRACE_MAX_DEPTH_CEILING.

max_paths.description: Path-count ceiling for BFS enumeration (ignored under A*, which always returns at most one shortest path). Bounded [1, 50].

edge_types.description: Optional inclusive filter against contracts/edge-types.json (semantic + operational unions). Unknown edge types → 422. null or omitted means no filter.
